name: steve
title_zh: 乔布斯会怎么砍你的产品，这里能问
tagline_zh: 功能堆到二十个、自己都说不清一句话卖点的时候，它不给鼓励，只给判决：留哪个、砍哪个、下一刀落在哪。
tagline_en: When your feature list hits twenty and you can't pitch it in one line, it gives a verdict: keep, cut, and the.
desc_en: Think like Steve Jobs about whatever the user is building and give them his verdict, the insight underneath it, what to cut, the next move, or the one sentence that sells it. Use this skill whenever the user asks what Steve Jobs would say, think, do, cut or ship; wants brutally honest product feedback; has too many features or ideas and cannot decide what to drop; cannot explain their product, rep
why_zh: 它先逼你回答「这到底卖什么」，再顺着这个答案往回砍功能，而不是先夸再补建议。
why_en: It forces the one-line pitch first, then cuts features backward from that answer instead of praising first.
limit_zh: 只给判断和取舍，不写代码、不做用户调研、不替你验证市场；产品还停在纯想法、连一句话卖点都答不上来时，它多半只会反问你。
limit_en: Verdicts and cuts only: no code, no user research, no market validation. With a pure idea and no one-line pitch, expect questions back.
title_en: Ask what Steve Jobs would cut from your product
